lorenz.def: Placeholder: a curve of cumulative income share against cumulative household share.

gini.def: Placeholder: the area between the line of equality and the Lorenz curve over the area under the line.

progressive-tax.def: Placeholder: a tax that takes a larger share of a larger income.

transfer-payment.def: Placeholder: a payment from the government that buys no good or service in return.

income-wealth.def: Placeholder: an unequal spread of income or of wealth across households.
